proving_policy: fresh actual native binary per sample; fixture, program and key initialization excluded from witness+prove; no pk_decode metric
memory_method: macOS /usr/bin/time -l directly wraps the native binary; whole native process peak footprint and RSS, including initialization and keys
worker_policy: 1/6 are requested backend worker configurations, not a guarantee of total OS threads; requested_threads and actual_threads record reported configuration. Native MSM may use bounded nested worker pools.
circuit_stats_method: Shared Barretenberg WASM chonkStats for structure only (no proving or verification); Rust counts from prepared native manifests

backend_notes.chonk: Exact PR Chonk app + registry/kernel/hiding fold
backend_notes.groth16: Arkworks Groth16: shared ACIR application relations and private link equalities; canonical compressed proof. Native QAP streams the prepared r1cs.bin matrix plan through BufReader; WASM has a RAM-loaded plan.
backend_notes.provekit: ProveKit low-level WHIR over the same merged R1CS; non-SPARK verifier retains full R1CS

qualification: Native integration smoke observations: one proving sample per configuration, not a stabilized performance baseline. Initial registration sampling overlapped a brief browser report inspection. Native measurements use the same fixtures and prepared keys as the separately linked WASM report. Use the documented five-sample command on an idle host for repeated analysis.
